# hyperfluid_bifrost (Data Source)

The cluster's query-layer (Bifrost) connection endpoints and feature configuration. Bifrost is a per-deployment singleton, so this data source takes no arguments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Bifrost is the cluster's query layer — a per-deployment singleton, so this
# data source takes no arguments.
data "hyperfluid_bifrost" "this" {}

output "bifrost_rest_url" {
  value = data.hyperfluid_bifrost.this.rest_url
}

output "bifrost_pgwire_endpoint" {
  value = data.hyperfluid_bifrost.this.pgwire_endpoint
}

output "bifrost_graphql_enabled" {
  value = data.hyperfluid_bifrost.this.features.graphql_enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `features` (Attributes) Which Bifrost query features are enabled on this deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))
- `graphql_url_template` (String) GraphQL URL template — substitute a Data Dock id for `{data_dock_id}`.
- `pgwire_endpoint` (String) PostgreSQL wire-protocol endpoint as `host:port`.
- `rest_url` (String) REST / OpenAPI base URL (e.g. `https://bifrost.example.com`).

<a id="nestedatt--features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `features`

Read-Only:

- `full_text_search_enabled` (Boolean) Full-text search is enabled.
- `graphql_enabled` (Boolean) GraphQL API is enabled.
- `mcp_enabled` (Boolean) MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoint is enabled.
- `openapi_enabled` (Boolean) OpenAPI / REST access is enabled.
- `postgresql_enabled` (Boolean) PostgreSQL wire-protocol access is enabled.
- `vector_search_enabled` (Boolean) Vector search is enabled.
